title: The Silent Tenant
description: Apartment 302 has gone quiet. The tenant hasn't been seen in nine days, but the neighbours still hear water running and a chair dragging at 3 a.m. The landlady wants it 'handled discreetly'. Something stayed behind when the tenant left.

quests.title: Ask the neighbours
quests.description: Mrs. Fujimoto knows more than she says. Earn enough trust to get the master key.
quests.objective: Raise the landlady's trust to 40 and obtain the key to 302.

quests.title: Find the true name
quests.description: A residual echo can be dismissed if you speak the name it answered to in life.
quests.objective: Recover the tenant's name from the mail in the laundry room, then confront the echo.
